Sandbox: fluid simulator

Left mouse button: Add stuff.
Right mouse button: Remove stuff.
1-9: Select tool
    1: Stone.
    2: Sand.
    3: Water.
    4. Lava.
    4: Mist.
    5. Foam.
I: Simulate erosion
Scroll wheel: Adjust tool radius.
Scroll wheel + left ctrl: Adjust tool strength (Amount).
Camera control:
WASD: Pan camera.
Q & E: Rotate camera.
R & F: Zoom in and out.
